stories.headline: OpenAI president's political spending draws scrutiny
stories.summary: OpenAI President Greg Brockman calls for federal AI safeguards, while a political group he helped fund backs candidates skeptical of restrictions. OpenAI says his $25 million contribution was personal; critics question the apparent conflict.

stories.headline: SpaceX and Tesla form merger committees
stories.summary: Musk said a merger could benefit AI, chip and robotics work after SpaceX reported its first quarterly profit. Independent committees are discussing a deal, but no terms are agreed and Musk cautioned that a transaction may never occur.

stories.headline: States prepare to shadow federal election monitors
stories.summary: DOJ plans roughly 1,000 election monitors across all 50 states, about triple the previous midterm deployment. Some states will shadow them over intimidation and federal-overreach concerns; DOJ says its aim is civil-rights compliance.

stories.headline: Putin meets US envoy over Ukraine ceasefire
stories.summary: Russian agencies say Putin met US envoy Steve Witkoff for talks on ending the war. Witkoff reportedly said there was a basis for a ceasefire and urged renewed Russia-US-Ukraine talks; no agreement was announced.

stories.headline: Abyei official says drone strike killed over 150
stories.summary: An Abyei official blamed Sudan's military for a market strike that killed at least 153 people, but provided no evidence. Reuters verified aftermath video but could not determine responsibility; Sudan's army did not respond.
